notes: Root section uses columns='100' (single full-width column) per target shape, bg_edge2edge=true for full-bleed hero, container_type='none' so the carousel spans the viewport (matches the demo 01-home.yml pattern). hero-slider-container placed in col_1 with all real props from its manifest (transition/autoplay/interval_ms/pause_on_hover/show_indicators/show_controls/slider_height enum '700'/controller_color 'white'). Three hero-slide children live in the container's 'slides' slot. hero-slide is fully prop-driven (its only slot-like content is the 'content' rich-text prop and 'media' image prop), so all copy is in inputs, not child nodes. First slide has active=true so the carousel opens on it (manifest notes container auto-activates first if none active; set explicitly for clarity). content is passed as an HTML string per the contentMediaType:text/html prop; at build time this may be wrapped as {value, format} like the demo. media image prop omitted (no media entity available at design time; slides fall back to the manifest example placeholder / overlay bg). All button_url values are real paths, never '#'. All enum values (title_size h1, overlay_opacity opacity-50, button_variant btn-primary, text_color text-white, media_position inherit) verified against hero-slide.component.yml.

label: Hero Split
notes: hero-side-by-side is fully prop-driven (no slots per its .component.yml), so all content lives in its inputs and there are no child leaf nodes. Root section uses columns='100' (single column) with the hero placed in col_1. Section kept visually neutral (container-fluid, no bg) so the hero's own bg_edge2edge full-bleed background is used. Props/enums taken verbatim from the two manifests: section.columns enum '100'; hero image uses the shipped example asset path; image_position=left (image start) for a split hero; button_url uses a real path '/get-started' (not '#'). All enum values (background_color=bg-light, content_color=text-dark, button_variant=btn-primary, button_size=btn-lg, vertical_padding=py-5, align=text-start, heading_level=2) are real. No component_version/uuid included per instructions.

label: Media Banner Intro

label: Feature Grid (Icons)

Each of col_1..col_3 holds one organisms/card-icon, which is fully prop-driven (no slots) — all content lives in its inputs. card-icon props verified against manifest: text, description (HTML), text_align, icon (enum without bi- prefix), icon_size, background_color, shadow, has_padding, url, button_label, button_variant. icon values chosen from the manifest enum (search, people, check). background_color=bg-body and shadow=shadow to match card defaults. label: Feature Cards
notes: Root atoms/section with columns=33-33-33 (3 equal columns) and vertical_alignment=align-items-stretch + each card equal_height=true for equal-height cards across the row (per AGENTS.md §7). Optional heading placed in header_slot. Each col_1..col_3 holds one organisms/card-text (slot: content) containing heading (level 3), text, and button atoms. Prop names verified against section.component.yml (columns, gutter, container_type, vertical_alignment, background_color, padding_*, margin_*, section_header) and card-text.component.yml (card_border, padded, equal_height, background_color, corner_style, stretched_link). Leaf atom props (heading: heading_text/level; text: text{value,format}/text_size/text_color; button: label/href{uri,options}/variant/outline/size/radius/icon/target/alignment) taken from real usage in 05-features.yml. Links use internal:/ paths, never '#'. Buttons use uri-object form as stored by Canvas. Card icon images omitted (icon_image optional; card renders as plain text card when empty).

label: Featured Media Split
notes: Root section uses columns='100' (single full-width column) per target shape; card-featured lives in col_1. card-featured is a media+content organism: media_position='start' with a ratio, and its content slot holds heading/text/button leaf atoms (its own inner grid handles the split, so the outer section stays 1-column). Section vertical_alignment=align-items-center and container_type=container mirror the real About Varbase demo page. Heading atom uses heading_text/level (observed props); text atom uses text object {value, format: canvas_html_block} + text_color (observed); button atom uses label + href.uri (internal:/features) + variant/size/outline (observed in demo). No media_image set (optional; card-featured shows a placeholder when empty). Links use real internal paths, never '#'. component_version/uuid omitted as instructed.

label: Pricing Row
notes: Root atoms/section with columns=33-33-33 and vertical_alignment=align-items-stretch so the three pricing cards render equal-height (per AGENTS.md §7 equal-height guidance, paired with each card being emphasized via promote on the middle one). card-pricing is fully prop-driven (no slots), so all copy lives in inputs — no child nodes. symbol_position is the only required prop and is set on every card. Middle card (col_2) has promote:true plus badge_text and border-primary to read as the highlighted plan. button_url uses real paths (/contact-us, /sign-up), never '#'. Features use the card's `text` HTML-list prop. All enums/defaults taken directly from card-pricing.component.yml and section.component.yml.

label: Logos Strip
notes: Root atoms/section uses columns '16-16-16-16-16-16' (the 6-equal-column preset) so exactly six columns render. section_header enabled to show a header region with a heading + supporting text via atoms/heading and atoms/text. Each col_1..col_6 holds one organisms/card-logo (card-logo is fully prop-driven, noUI, no slots — logo goes in its `media` image prop). card-logo props used are all real: media (image object), url (uri-reference path), shadow (enum, default shadow-none), alignment (enum, default center chosen for a logo strip). Section vertical_alignment align-items-center + horizontal_alignment text-center to keep logos visually aligned. All url paths are real (/partners/...), never '#'. Image src values point at the shipped vartheme placeholder logo asset. heading uses content/level props; text uses value prop — inferred common atom props per task guidance.

label: Call To Action Band
notes: Root atoms/section with columns=100 (single full-width column). Edge-to-edge primary band achieved on the section (bg_edge2edge=true, background_color=bg-primary, container_type=container so inner content stays readable, generous vertical padding pt-5/pb-5). The organisms/cta component is fully prop-driven (no slots per its manifest), so all heading/body/button content lives in its inputs — no child nodes. cta.background_color set to bg-none (band colour comes from the section) and content_color=text-white to read on the primary band. button_url uses a real path '/get-started' (never '#'; cta.button_url is uri-reference). Enums used are verbatim from the manifests: section.columns '100', section.background_color 'bg-primary', section.text_color 'text-white', section.horizontal_alignment 'text-center'; cta.level 2, cta.heading_size 'display-5', cta.text_align 'text-center', cta.button_variant 'btn-light' (light button for contrast on primary), cta.background_color 'bg-none', cta.content_color 'text-white'. cta requires text_align and level — both provided.

label: FAQ Accordion
notes: Root section uses columns='100' (single 100% column) as required by the target shape; header region enabled to carry an intro heading (section_header:true, header_slot). accordion-container props verified from manifest (id, flush, always_open, color enum text-bg-*); left color unset to use the default secondary-subtle design, flush:false. accordion-block props verified: title, heading_level (enum 2-6, default 3), open_by_default (bool), color (default 'inherit'); first item open_by_default:true, others false. Leaf body uses atoms/text with the {value,format} shape and text_size/text_color as seen in the demo canvas_page (format canvas_html_block). heading atom uses heading_text/level per demo usage. label: Two-column Intro + Card
notes: Root section uses columns=50-50 with section_header=true so header_slot renders. header_slot holds a section-title heading; col_1 has heading + text + button (link uses /features path); col_2 holds a card-text organism (prop-driven, padded + bordered) whose content slot has a heading + text. Atoms used: heading (heading_text/level/text_size/font_weight), text (text/text_size/text_color), button (label/href/variant/size/alignment). card-text is prop-driven for its chrome and exposes a single 'content' slot. All props/enums verified against the read manifests; no invented props. gutter/vertical_alignment left at sensible existing enums.
